# Elixir top-level arrays whose element is neither primitive nor named (a
# map, a nullable union): TypeScript asks for the element's module name and
# fails. With just-types there are no top-level modules.
input schema Maps {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": {"type": "integer"}}}
pipeline {"lang": "elixir"}

render elixir {}
render elixir {"rendererOptions": {"just-types": true}}
